name: Nicolas Cullen
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Nicolas Cullen as an author of “A multi-epoch triangulation of stereo ASTER images for Tasman Glacier elevation change”.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Nicholas Cullen as an author of “Seasonal snowpack mapping with drone photogrammetry”.

Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Nicolas J. Cullen as an author of “Snow depth distribution from high-resolution RPAS photogrammetry”.
GeoCart session 1 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society (archived programme page) lists Nicolas Cullen as an author of “Southern Alps snow resources from satellite photogrammetry”.

Aubrey Miller staff profile: NZGRC 2022 Matariki Project proceedings citation, University of Otago lists Nicolas Cullen as an author of “The Matariki Project: 3-D change detection with satellite photogrammetric mapping”.
SIRC NZ 2013 GIS and remote sensing proceedings citations, University of Otago lists Nicolas Cullen as an author of “Modelling ice retreat on Kilimanjaro using GIS”.
The University of Otago profile uses Nicolas Cullen; GeoCart sources also use Nicholas Cullen and Nicolas J. Cullen for glacier-mapping contributions.
